title: Update Favicon on All Pages
description: Ensure all pages (playgrounds, sketchpad, etc.) use the updated semio logo as favicon.
summary: Fixed sketchpad favicon white matte: round dark emblem SVG corners were transparent and qlmanage rasterized them white. `semioFaviconSvgMarkup` now injects an opaque `#001117` bleed rect for served/built `favicon.svg`; regenerated `favicon_dark_round_32x32.ico` from that markup. Removed duplicate sketchpad `public/favicon.*` files so the Vite favicon plugin is the single source (playgrounds already worked this way).
